mainEntity.name: How do I download a translation?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the Library, press Make available offline on a translation. It is then on this device in full.

mainEntity.name: How do I add my own translation from a file?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the Library, choose Add your own and pick a file: USFM, OSIS, USFX, Zefania, this app's JSON, a spreadsheet, or an eBible.org zip. It is checked against the canon, and nothing is uploaded.

mainEntity.name: How do I export or convert a translation?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the Library, open a translation's ⋯ menu and choose Export: a format, which books, what to include, compact or readable, and one file, gzipped or a zip.

mainEntity.name: How do I remove a translation?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the Library, press Remove on the translation. Notes and bookmarks stay: they belong to the passage, not the translation.
